title: Evergreen：东南山麓的新社区与持有成本
title_en: Evergreen: newer foothill neighborhoods and what they cost to hold
intro: 95135 在 San Jose 东南的 Evergreen 东侧，背靠 Diablo Range 山麓，San Felipe Rd 和 Yerba Buena Rd 是主要道路。这里多是 1990 到 2000 年代建的两层独立屋，卧室多，车库为双车位或三车位，The Villages 则是带门禁的 55 岁以上年龄限制社区。Evergreen Village Square、Village Square Branch Library、Evergreen Community Center 和 Evergreen Valley College 都在这个邮编内。片区里没有高速公路和轨道站，出门要先走地面干道到 US-101，这是房屋空间之外最需要衡量的一点。
intro_en: 95135 covers the eastern side of Evergreen in southeast San Jose, against the Diablo Range foothills, with San Felipe Rd and Yerba Buena Rd as the main roads. Most homes are two-story houses from the 1990s and 2000s with plenty of bedrooms and two- or three-car garages, while The Villages is a gated, age-restricted community for residents 55 and over. Evergreen Village Square, Village Square Branch Library, Evergreen Community Center and Evergreen Valley College are all in this ZIP code. There is no freeway or rail station in the area, so trips start on surface arterials out to US-101, and that is the main thing to weigh against the extra space.
buyer: 持有成本要逐户算：较新的社区可能有 HOA 和 CFD／Mello-Roos，只有税单和 HOA 文件能确认金额与期限。靠山的地址查 CAL FIRE 火险等级和州地质调查局的断层、滑坡图层，并在出价前拿到保险报价。The Villages 有自己的年龄和社区规则，购买前先读完文件。学校方面这一带属 Evergreen School District 和 East Side Union HSD，请按完整地址向学区核实。
buyer_en: Work out holding costs home by home. Newer neighborhoods may carry HOA dues and CFD or Mello-Roos assessments, and only the tax bill and HOA documents will confirm amounts and end dates. For addresses near the hills, check CAL FIRE hazard zones and the state fault and landslide layers, and get an insurance quote before you offer. The Villages has its own age and community rules, so read the documents before buying. Schools in this area fall under Evergreen School District and East Side Union HSD; confirm the full address with each district.
seller: 95135 的成交里既有普通独立屋，也有 The Villages 这样的年龄限制社区，邮编中位价不能直接用来定价，可比成交要留在同一类社区内。提前备好 HOA 月费、CFD 年额和到期年份，买家会把这些算进月供。山坡地块的景观、车道坡度和保险情况也要写进定价分析。
seller_en: Sales here include regular single-family homes and age-restricted communities such as The Villages, so the ZIP-wide median is not a pricing tool, and comparable sales should stay within the same kind of community. Have HOA dues, the annual CFD amount and its end date ready, since buyers will build them into the monthly cost. On hillside lots, the view, driveway slope and insurance picture all belong in the pricing analysis.
